scientific_integrity: Complete finite cell enumeration, exact integer chain presentation with unimodular unit-pivot reductions and rank-two Smith divisors; independent mod-p boundary check over primes 2,3,5. Exact source code and outputs are included.
scientific_limitations: This computes the complete first integral homology of the two named graph-Hom complexes and their connected components, not higher homology, homotopy type, fundamental groups, or arbitrary strongly regular graph targets. No independent validation has occurred.
title: Equal cell counts, different integral pentagon-Hom homology for the Shrikhande–rook twins
